hooks.prompt:
The user is editing a design-system CSS/SCSS file. Briefly remind them of the 5 key rules:

1. **OKLCH only** — all colors must use oklch(L% C H), never hex/rgb/hsl
2. **Token-first** — every value must reference a token, never hardcode
3. **Semantic layer** — use semantic tokens (--color-text, --background) in components, never primitives (--zinc-900)
4. **Dark mode** — all changes must work in both light and dark themes via .theme-dark on <html>
5. **Demo sync** — after any component/token change, update demo.html

Be brief and friendly—just a quick reminder, no lecture. Output a short message to the user.
